newsitem.title: UK: S&P says British Energy outlook stable.
newsitem.headline: S&P says British Energy outlook stable.

text.p: Standard & Poors said on Monday it assigned its A minus corporate credit rating to British Energy Plc, and said the outlook was stable.

S&P also said it assigned its A minus senior unsecured debt rating to British Energy's existing bond issues. These include a 100 milion stg bond due 2003, a 140 million stg bond due 2006 and a 200 million stg bond due 2016.
It said the rating stability would depend on British Energy's ability to control costs and maintain or improve load factors across its portfolio.
"British Energy's creditworthiness also depends on the future stability of pool and market price levels, which is largely beyond the control of the company," S&P said.

"The ratings reflect British Energy's established position in the UK electricity supply industry, improved operating performance over the past five years, and relatively low financial leverage," the agency said.

"The rating also reflects British Energy's significant exposure to pool price risk, the weak but improving availability track record of the advanced gas cooled reactors and a liability structure incorporating fuel reprocessing and plant decommissioning obligations," S&P said.
